rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something spreading through air, water, or another medium, whether it is made to spread or spreads on its own.

example.english: The disinfectant can slowly diffuse through the water.
example.traditional: 啲消毒藥水可以喺水入面慢慢擴散開。
example.jyutping: di1 siu1 duk6 joek6 seoi2 ho2 ji5 hai2 seoi2 jap6 min6 maan6 maan2 kwok3 saan3 hoi1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something spread out rather than concentrated, including effort, attention, or resources.

example.english: When there are too many people, everyone's attention becomes diffuse.
example.traditional: 人一多，大家嘅注意力就好分散。
example.jyutping: jan4 jat1 do1 daai6 gaa1 ge3 zyu3 ji3 lik6 zau6 hou2 fan1 saan3
